task.title: Resumable verified chunk receiver
task.specification: config={maxLength:integer 0..64}. Events begin={type:'begin',id,length}, chunk={type:'chunk',id,offset,bytes,checksum}, finish={type:'finish',id}. A legal begin length 0..maxLength starts a new active ID and clears bytes; repeating active ID with same length is ok and preserves bytes, different length is conflict and preserves bytes. Invalid length is invalid. A chunk/finish for another ID or no active transfer is ignored. Chunk checksum must equal sum(bytes)%251, bytes must be integers 0..255, offset a nonnegative integer, and offset+length<=declared length; otherwise invalid. Conflicting overlap rejects the ENTIRE chunk as conflict; matching overlap is allowed. Valid chunks fill known bytes, status=ok. Finish is incomplete unless every byte is known; otherwise complete and returns bytes, including [] for length zero. Output {status,id,received,data}, where id is active ID or null, received counts distinct known offsets, and data is full bytes ONLY on a complete finish, else null. Completed transfers remain active; future matching chunks/finishes are legal. No future trace is available. Return one JSON output per event; state is opaque JSON, initially null. Objects in outputs have exactly the documented keys; map keys are unordered, arrays are ordered. Sorted/lexicographic string order compares Unicode scalar values (code points), with a shorter prefix first. Numeric inputs/values and intermediate arithmetic are safe integers. Integral JSON number notations such as 1 and 1.0 denote the same number, while booleans are distinct. Strings contain Unicode scalar values (no unpaired surrogates). Decoded imported values outside these limits are invalid frames. There are at most 48 events. Unknown/invalid operations have the behavior below. Each instance starts fresh. Hidden ordinary cases vary legal values; boundary cases emphasize equality, empty data and duplicates; adversarial cases reorder and conflict; shift cases use longer traces and more identities within the same contract.

matchedCard.label: Wetland flood storage
matchedCard.relation: Temporary storage and slow release can spread an incoming surge over time and reduce a downstream peak. In a simplified flow balance, retained quantity changes with inflow and outflow; delaying movement does not by itself remove the incoming quantity.
assumptions: Release or another accounted outflow can restore capacity between surges.
Any other gain or loss is included in the flow balance.
matchedCard.boundary: Storage alone cannot absorb a sustained excess of inflow indefinitely. A reduced peak is not evidence that the total incoming quantity disappeared.
matchedCard.source_fact: EPA describes wetlands trapping and slowly releasing water, slowing runoff, and storing peak flows. The finite-capacity balance is an explicitly stated abstraction of storage behavior.

sources.title: Incorporating Wetland Restoration and Protection in Planning Documents

shuffledCard.label: Theatrical lighting cue tracking
shuffledCard.relation: A value entered in a sequence persists through later positions that contain no replacement for it. A new entry can therefore alter later states. A cue-only change limits that propagation by restoring the prior downstream value at the next position.
assumptions: The sequence uses tracking rather than independent complete states.
Explicit changes can be distinguished from values inherited from earlier positions.
shuffledCard.boundary: An absent change is not an explicit reset. Forward-tracking and cue-only editing have different scopes and cannot be assumed interchangeable.
shuffledCard.source_fact: ETC documents values tracking forward through cues and a cue-only operation that prevents an inserted or merged change from altering subsequent cues.

initial.explanation: The conditional rule is state conservation: after each event, the output reports exactly the active transfer and its distinct known byte positions; accepted chunks add only nonconflicting bytes, while invalid, conflicting, and irrelevant events leave state unchanged. A counterexample is an overlapping chunk with one differing byte: rejecting only that byte would incorrectly preserve the rest, so the entire chunk must be rejected.
initial.mapping: config.maxLength and event fields map to transfer state {id,len,bytes}; null byte entries represent unknown positions. Output status, id, received, and data are a direct projection of the post-event state and operation result.
initial.assumptions: Inputs use the documented JSON value domains; malformed or unknown operations are treated as ignored, and malformed chunk payloads as invalid. IDs use strict equality.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!applies(input)||!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;let s=null;for(let k=0;k<input.events.length;k++){let e=input.events[k],st='ignored',id=s?s.id:null,d=null;if(e&&e.type==='begin'){if(Number.isInteger(e.length)&&e.length>=0&&e.length<=input.config.maxLength){if(s&&s.id===e.id&&s.len!==e.length)st='conflict';else{if(!s||s.id!==e.id)s={id:e.id,len:e.length,b:Array(e.length).fill(null)};st='ok'}}else st='invalid'}else if(e&&e.type==='chunk'){if(s&&s.id===e.id){let b=e.bytes,good=Array.isArray(b)&&Number.isInteger(e.offset)&&e.offset>=0&&e.offset+(b?b.length:0)<=s.len&&Number.isInteger(e.checksum);let sum=0;if(good)for(let x of b){if(!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255){good=false;break}sum+=x}if(good&&sum%251!==e.checksum)good=false;if(!good)st='invalid';else{let c=false;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)if(s.b[e.offset+i]!==null&&s.b[e.offset+i]!==b[i])c=true;if(c)st='conflict';else{for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)s.b[e.offset+i]=b[i];st='ok'}}}}else if(e&&e.type==='finish'&&s&&s.id===e.id){let complete=s.b.every(x=>x!==null);st=complete?'complete':'incomplete';if(complete)d=s.b.slice()}let r=0;if(s)for(let x of s.b)if(x!==null)r++;let want={status:st,id:id,received:r,data:d};if(JSON.stringify(want)!==JSON.stringify(output[k]))return false}return true}
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state;if(!s)s={id:null,len:0,b:[]};let st='ignored',d=null;if(event&&event.type==='begin'){if(Number.isInteger(event.length)&&event.length>=0&&event.length<=config.maxLength){if(s.id!==null&&s.id===event.id&&s.len!==event.length)st='conflict';else{if(s.id===null||s.id!==event.id)s={id:event.id,len:event.length,b:Array(event.length).fill(null)};st='ok'}}else st='invalid'}else if(event&&event.type==='chunk'){if(s.id!==null&&s.id===event.id){let b=event.bytes,good=Array.isArray(b)&&Number.isInteger(event.offset)&&event.offset>=0&&Number.isInteger(event.checksum)&&event.offset+(b?b.length:0)<=s.len,sum=0;if(good)for(let x of b){if(!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255){good=false;break}sum+=x}if(good&&sum%251!==event.checksum)good=false;if(!good)st='invalid';else{let c=false;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)if(s.b[event.offset+i]!==null&&s.b[event.offset+i]!==b[i])c=true;if(c)st='conflict';else{for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)s.b[event.offset+i]=b[i];st='ok'}}}}else if(event&&event.type==='finish'&&s.id!==null&&s.id===event.id){let complete=s.b.every(x=>x!==null);st=complete?'complete':'incomplete';if(complete)d=s.b.slice()}let r=0;for(let x of s.b)if(x!==null)r++;return{state:s,output:{status:st,id:s.id,received:r,data:d}}}

final.explanation: The implementation maintains one active transfer with a declared length and nullable byte slots. Valid begins either create a fresh transfer or preserve a matching one; changing an active transfer’s length conflicts. Chunks are accepted only when their bounds, byte values, checksum, and overlaps are valid. Any conflicting overlap rejects the entire chunk. Finish reports complete data only when every byte is known; irrelevant events are ignored and invalid operations preserve state.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){let s=state;if(!s||s.a!==true)s={a:false,id:null,len:0,b:[]};let status="ignored",data=null;if(event&&event.type==="begin"){let n=event.length;if(Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<=config.maxLength){if(s.a&&s.id===event.id&&s.len!==n)status="conflict";else{if(!s.a||s.id!==event.id)s={a:true,id:event.id,len:n,b:Array(n).fill(null)};status="ok"}}else status="invalid"}else if(event&&event.type==="chunk"&&s.a&&s.id===event.id){let b=event.bytes,good=Array.isArray(b)&&Number.isInteger(event.offset)&&event.offset>=0&&Number.isInteger(event.checksum)&&event.offset+b.length<=s.len,sum=0;if(good)for(let x of b){if(!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255){good=false;break}sum+=x}if(good&&sum%251!==event.checksum)good=false;if(!good)status="invalid";else{let conflict=false;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)if(s.b[event.offset+i]!==null&&s.b[event.offset+i]!==b[i]){conflict=true;break}if(conflict)status="conflict";else{for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)s.b[event.offset+i]=b[i];status="ok"}}}else if(event&&event.type==="finish"&&s.a&&s.id===event.id){let complete=true;for(let x of s.b)if(x===null){complete=false;break}status=complete?"complete":"incomplete";if(complete)data=s.b.slice()}let received=0;if(s.a)for(let x of s.b)if(x!==null)received++;return{state:s,output:{status:status,id:s.a?s.id:null,received:received,data:data}}}

initial.explanation: A resumable receiver stores one active transfer, its declared length, and known byte positions. Valid chunks are checked before mutation; conflicting overlaps reject the entire chunk. Finishing exposes data only when all positions are known.
initial.mapping: The active transfer maps to state.id and state.len; byte conservation maps to state.b, where null means unknown and non-null entries are retained across events.
initial.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated JSON limits. Invalid operations produce invalid status while preserving active state; mismatched IDs produce ignored status.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const x of output){if(!x||x.data!==null&&x.status!=="complete")return false;if(!["ok","ignored","invalid","conflict","incomplete","complete"].includes(x.status))return false;if(typeof x.received!=="number"||x.received<0)return false}return true}
initial.program: function solve({config,state,event}){const max=config.maxLength;let s=state||{id:null,len:0,b:[]};const out=st=>({data:null,id:s.id,received:s.b.reduce((n,x)=>n+(x!==null),0),status:st});const same=(a,b)=>a===b;let t=event&&event.type;if(t==='begin'){let n=event.length;if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<0||n>max)return{state:s,output:out('invalid')};if(s.id===null||!same(s.id,event.id)){s={id:event.id,len:n,b:Array(n).fill(null)};return{state:s,output:out('ok')}}if(s.len!==n)return{state:s,output:out('conflict')};return{state:s,output:out('ok')}}if(s.id===null||!same(event&&event.id,s.id))return{state:s,output:out('ignored')};if(t==='finish'){let complete=s.b.every(x=>x!==null);let o=out(complete?'complete':'incomplete');if(complete)o.data=s.b.slice();return{state:s,output:o}}if(t!=='chunk')return{state:s,output:out('invalid')};let a=event.bytes,o=event.offset;if(!Array.isArray(a)||!Number.isInteger(o)||o<0||o+a.length>s.len||!Number.isInteger(event.checksum)||a.some(x=>!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255)||a.reduce((q,x)=>q+x,0)%251!==event.checksum)return{state:s,output:out('invalid')};for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(s.b[o+i]!==null&&s.b[o+i]!==a[i])return{state:s,output:out('conflict')};for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)s.b[o+i]=a[i];return{state:s,output:out('ok')}}

final.explanation: Implements one active resumable transfer. It validates lengths, byte ranges, offsets, checksums, and whole-chunk overlap conflicts before mutation. Matching chunks are idempotent, completed transfers remain active, and finish exposes data only when every byte is known. Identity comparison distinguishes booleans from numbers and compares structured JSON values recursively.
final.program: function solve({config,state,event}){function eq(a,b){if(typeof a!==typeof b)return false;if(a===b)return true;if(typeof a==='number'&&Number.isFinite(a)&&Number.isFinite(b))return a===b;if(Array.isArray(a)&&Array.isArray(b)){if(a.length!==b.length)return false;for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(!eq(a[i],b[i]))return false;return true}if(a&&b&&typeof a==='object'&&!Array.isArray(a)&&!Array.isArray(b)){let ak=Object.keys(a),bk=Object.keys(b);if(ak.length!==bk.length)return false;for(let k of ak)if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(b,k)||!eq(a[k],b[k]))return false;return true}return false}let s=state||{active:false,id:null,len:0,b:[]};function count(){let n=0;for(let x of s.b)if(x!==null)n++;return n}function out(status,data=null){return{state:s,output:{status:status,id:s.active?s.id:null,received:count(),data:data}}}let t=event&&event.type;if(t==='begin'){let n=event.length;if(!Number.isInteger(n)||n<0||n>config.maxLength)return out('invalid');if(!s.active||!eq(s.id,event.id)){s={active:true,id:event.id,len:n,b:Array(n).fill(null)};return out('ok')}if(s.len!==n)return out('conflict');return out('ok')}if(t!=='chunk'&&t!=='finish')return out('invalid');if(!s.active||!eq(event&&event.id,s.id))return out('ignored');if(t==='finish'){let complete=true;for(let x of s.b)if(x===null){complete=false;break}return complete?out('complete',s.b.slice()):out('incomplete')}let a=event.bytes,o=event.offset;if(!Array.isArray(a)||!Number.isInteger(o)||o<0||o+a.length>s.len||!Number.isInteger(event.checksum))return out('invalid');let sum=0;for(let x of a){if(!Number.isInteger(x)||x<0||x>255)return out('invalid');sum+=x}if(sum%251!==event.checksum)return out('invalid');for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(s.b[o+i]!==null&&s.b[o+i]!==a[i])return out('conflict');for(let i=0;i<a.length;i++)s.b[o+i]=a[i];return out('ok')}

initial.explanation: Track one active transfer. Verified chunks are applied only when structurally valid and non-conflicting; invalid, conflicting, and irrelevant events preserve the prior transfer state as required.
initial.mapping: The opaque state stores active id, declared length, and an array whose null entries are unknown bytes. Output derives id, distinct received count, status, and complete data from those variables.
initial.assumptions: Malformed or unknown events produce status invalid while preserving state. Event ids are compared by JavaScript JSON value equality; legal task inputs otherwise follow the stated scalar constraints.
initial.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(const o of output){if(!o||typeof o!=="object"||Object.keys(o).length!==4||!("status"in o)||!("id"in o)||!("received"in o)||!("data"in o))return false;if(o.data==="__changed")return false}return true}

final.explanation: Tracks the active transfer, preserving verified bytes across events. Begins validate lengths; matching begins preserve data, while conflicting lengths are rejected. Chunks are ignored for inactive IDs, rejected as invalid when malformed, and rejected as conflicts when overlapping bytes disagree. Finishes report incomplete or return the complete byte array.
